> **Historical survey, not a complete archive.**
>
> This is a backfill over the last 90 days (2026-06-22 to 2026-09-21), assembled by running 28 queries across 4 time slices of Google News search.
>
> Coverage is necessarily partial. RSS and government sources have no archive — they carry days of history, not years — so they contribute nothing here. Google News returns a bounded number of results per query, ranks by its own relevance rather than completeness, and drops articles whose publishers have since removed them. Older months will look thinner than recent ones, and that reflects the index, not the market.
>
> Treat absence of a story as unproven, not as evidence it did not happen.
